Declare one of: Telo.Callable, Telo.Invocable, Telo.Mount, Telo.Provider, Telo.Runnable, Telo.Service, Telo.Sink, Telo.Type.

Telo.Definition 'Runner': 'Telo.Executable' cannot be declared as a capability: Anything control can be transferred to with call arguments — a resource that is invoked or run. A reference slot accepting either says so once with this constraint. It names no lifecycle of its own, so no kind declares it as its role: a kind declares the role it implements. Declare one of: Telo.Callable, Telo.Invocable, Telo.Mount, Telo.Provider, Telo.Runnable, Telo.Service, Telo.Sink, Telo.Type.
